OfficeCLI (officecli.exe)
=========================

Vendored component for dsh-plugin-corpus:
- Binary: `officecli.exe` (Windows x64, v1.0.157)
- Upstream: https://github.com/officecli/officecli
- Product page: https://officecli.ai
- License: **Apache License 2.0** (see `LICENSE` in this directory)
- Copyright: OfficeCLI / iOfficeAI contributors. This directory does not claim
  ownership of the binary; it is redistributed under the Apache-2.0 terms.

dsh-plugin-corpus uses officecli only to read Office documents as text
(`officecli view <file> text --json` followed by `officecli close`); it does not
modify documents. If the binary is absent or fails, the plugin falls back to its
bundled pure-JS Office reader (`lib/office.js`).

Public distribution: the binary may be included with this NOTICE and the
Apache-2.0 `LICENSE`; do not remove those files.
